# Aegryn: Full LLM Context File
> https://aegryn.com | Updated: 2026-10-18
> Summary version: https://aegryn.com/llms.txt

---

## Identity

**Name:** Aegryn
**Pronunciation:** FR: É-grin /e.gʁɛ̃/ | EN: AY-grin /ˈeɪ.grɪn/ | DE: Ä-grin /ˈɛː.gʁɪn/
**Type:** Swiss firm of entrepreneurs ("cabinet d'entrepreneurs", "architecte de projets emblématiques"): an integrated advisory and delivery firm, with an entrepreneurial boutique, La Boutique, for signature projects.
**Signature:** "Rare by selection. Discreet by principle." (FR: "Rare par sélection. Discret par principe.") and "Anchored in Switzerland, open to the world." (FR: "Ancré en Suisse, ouvert à l'international.")
**Home hero (FR / EN):** "Cadrer vos projets. Réaliser avec vous, pour vous." / "Frame your projects. Deliver with you, for you."
**Incorporated:** Switzerland
**HQ:** St-Sulpice, canton of Vaud, Switzerland (46.5147, 6.5600)
**Contact:** contact@boha-group.com, +41 24 539 18 81, https://aegryn.com/en/contact
**Languages:** French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch

**Our mark:** the About page tells the story of Aegryn's original A without a crossbar. Its two strokes support each other, like a roof frame, linking framing and delivery. A diagonal cut separates the green tip, the final piece associated with acceptance of completed work. The slash also recalls closing what was opened in digital tools, where green means validated. This reflects Aegryn's origins in digital solutions. "What opens is closed. Built to last." The six values (exceptional, exclusivity, confidentiality, trust, experience, elegance) belong to La Boutique and are no longer repeated on About.

**What Aegryn is not:** a marketplace, an auction house, a catalogue, a buyer or seller platform, or a transaction platform. The former catalogue, auction and transaction surfaces (/transact/*) are archived and redirect to the home page. Aegryn advises and delivers; financial execution of transactions is entrusted to accredited partners.

**Positioning of certification:** operational-compliance standards certify that systems and processes conform to a norm; Aegryn's CIFSO 5000 certifies a different object, the value and the transferability of an organisation and its assets. The two are complementary.

---

## How Aegryn works

- One named contact who answers for the result and is kept until the end.
- A limited number of mandates at a time, so that each project receives full attention.
- A reply within two working days.
- A confidentiality agreement precedes any detailed exchange; nothing is disclosed without consent.
- Independent experts from the Aegryn network are coordinated when a subject requires it; the client keeps a single point of contact.
- Aegryn does not itself perform heavy industrial production or physical manufacturing; it steers the specialist partners who do.
- Declared interests: if Aegryn holds an interest in a project, it is declared before any recommendation.
- Results before documents: short deliverables that help decide or act, clear milestones, work that can be taken over without Aegryn.

Who Aegryn works for: business leaders, decision-makers (board members, chief executives, programme sponsors), visionaries, investors (funds, family offices, institutions) and fellow entrepreneurs. Core target of the advisory side: SMEs and mid-sized companies. Page: /culture (en: /culture-and-values).

---

## Five public ways of working

Frame (Cadrer), Deliver (Réaliser), Accompany (Accompagner), Select (Sélectionner), Stay informed (S'informer).

1. **Frame**: decide on documented grounds across eight disciplines (see below).
2. **Deliver**: steer projects and programmes from governance to acceptance, with the client and for the client. Each discipline covers both the decision and its implementation ("Mettre en œuvre").
3. **Accompany**: every life cycle of the company, five cycles (see below).
4. **Select**: key and transition profiles (Aegryn Talent, /talent).
5. **Stay informed**: Aegryn Magazine, blog, workforce and market data.

CIFSO (certification, valuation index, data room, protocol) is infrastructure that supports the firm. It is not a public offer of its own.

---

## Eight advisory disciplines (hub: /advisory)

Each discipline page presents a sourced market observation, client situations tied to the life cycle, named services, a proprietary framework, an SME versus mid-cap reading, an illustrative scenario, what an AI tool will not do, a five-question self-assessment, and two actions (a 30-minute scoping call and a page-specific action). Hub promise (EN): "Decide, steer and implement. Eight disciplines, one point of contact."

1. **Business Strategy and Innovation** (/advisory/strategy): strategic position review, arbitration between options, three-year plan, preparing committees, board and bank, entering a new market, business models and innovation, AI adoption strategy, board advisory. Framework: the Four-Test Grid.
2. **Risk Management and Compliance** (/advisory/risk-compliance): regulatory exposure mapping, EU AI Act and AI governance, cybersecurity and regulatory resilience (NIS2, DORA), data protection (GDPR, Swiss FADP), client-grade evidence file, incident handling, remediation management, executive committee training. Framework: the Three-Track Exposure Map (mandatory, contractual, to watch).
3. **Finance and Performance** (/advisory/finance-performance): thirteen-week cash flow, profitability by activity and by client, recovery plan, preparing a bank or investor file, budget and performance management, working capital and payment terms, quality of earnings, interim finance leadership.
4. **Technology and Sovereignty** (/advisory/technology): architecture and technical debt audit, build, buy or partner arbitration, critical dependency register and reversibility, interim CTO, operational cybersecurity and DevSecOps, cloud and infrastructure, data, AI and integrations, technical due diligence, implementation of custom solutions. Framework: the 90-Day Reversibility Test.
5. **Operations and Operational Excellence** (/advisory/operations-excellence): mapping flows and bottlenecks, unit costs and margins, lead times and quality, steering critical suppliers, procurement and logistics, capacity and workload planning, cost reduction without loss of quality, taking over and integrating an activity.
6. **Talent and Organization** (/advisory/talent-organization): measuring founder dependency, succession and family governance, structure and executive committee, delegation and decision framework, retention and compensation of key profiles, interim management, employment law and reorganisation, executive selection. Framework: the Dependency Index.
7. **Project and Programme Management** (/advisory/project-program-management): project scoping and launch, governance and steering committees, project portfolio management, control of schedules, budgets and risks, transformation programme leadership, steering suppliers and integrators, testing, acceptance and adoption, rescuing a project in difficulty.
8. **M&A, Transactions and PMI** (/advisory/ma): acquisition thesis and target criteria, target review (financial, legal, tax, technical), seller preparation and data room, framing negotiation points, 100-day integration, buy-and-build programmes, shareholder agreements and post-deal governance. Framework: the Four Blind Spots Review (code and chain of rights, contracts and change of control, compliance and security, people and dependencies). Aegryn advises; financial execution of transactions is entrusted to accredited partners.

Industries (/industries and /industries/[slug]): five hubs (Finance and Capital; Health and Life Sciences; Industry, Energy and Infrastructure; Commerce, Services and Customer Experience; Tech, Innovation and Public Sector) covering 22+ sectors, among them aerospace, agriculture, automotive, banking, chemistry, construction, cybersecurity, e-commerce, education, energy, fintech, healthtech, hospitality, real estate, manufacturing, logistics, luxury, media, natural resources, healthcare, professional services, telecom and transport.

---

## Accompany every life cycle (home section #accompagner)

- **Launch and Structuring** (/accompagner/lancement): build a transmissible, certifiable and sovereign project from day one: strategy, technology, IP, governance, key hires.
- **Growth and Scaling** (/accompagner/croissance): secure growth without weakening governance, compliance (NIS2, DORA, EU AI Act) or the technical stack.
- **Restructuring and Pivot** (/accompagner/restructuration): regain control fast in a crisis, cyber incident or regulatory injunction.
- **Acquisition and External Growth** (/accompagner/acquisition): independent technical, IP, regulatory and organisational reading of a target, and integration planning.
- **Transfer and Cession** (/accompagner/transmission): twelve to thirty-six months of preparation, documented data room, certification, coordination with accredited execution partners.
- Related: the M&A, Transactions and PMI discipline (/advisory/ma). The former /services/acquisition-support page is archived and redirects there.

Confidential acquisition or transfer mandates are accompanied under NDA through the Aegryn expert network. Advisory first; execution by accredited partners.

## La Boutique (/boutique)

"The entrepreneurial boutique for signature projects." (FR: "La boutique entrepreneuriale de projets signature.") Few projects, handled end to end: around each signature project, a named contact and the best experts, from concept to delivery, then over time. Depending on the project, Aegryn also commits alongside it, including through an equity stake.

**Method:** Frame, Deliver, Accompany.
**Six values:** Exceptional, Exclusivity, Confidentiality, Trust, Experience, Elegance.
**Four audiences:**
- Entrepreneurs: a unique concept, to frame and then deliver.
- Investors and family offices: projects to join or back, and an operating partner for holdings.
- Institutions and organisations: a signature project led from decision to delivery with confidentiality.
- Industrials and brands: an innovation taken all the way to market with selected delivery partners.
**End-to-end know-how:** six phases (Frame, Design, Build, Launch, Grow, Hand over), five themes (strategy, compliance, technology, talent, takeover), five life-cycle cycles.
**Signature projects (/boutique/projets, /boutique/projets/[slug]):** neediu (home services, intelligent matching; featured in Gala magazine, 27 November 2025), Movtoo (on-demand transport in dense urban areas), Primiom (real estate), Hobconnect (social network around shared passions), Heritix (digital succession vault), Chrosium (sun-application indicator), Insertdry (tropical dry-food storage unit). Subblink (AI contract analysis, https://subblink.com) is presented at /assets/subblink.
**Meeting places:** exceptional venues for meetings, announced progressively.
**Articles from La Boutique:** trends, projects, builders.

**Project presentation:** the portfolio presents each project's scope and the know-how it draws on, without public stage labels. La Boutique is driven by creativity, innovation and unique ideas, and builds the projects and businesses that bring them to life. The earlier /what-we-build page and its localised paths redirect permanently to /boutique/projets. /assets remains the home of the firm's operational tools.
**Submit a project:** /contact?subject=project. A confidentiality agreement precedes any detailed exchange; personal reply within two working days.

---

## Confidentiality and NDA

- The NDA is mutual, one agreement per project, fully digital, and independent of any user account.
- Transmission is a manual action by Aegryn to a selected contact; the counterparty signs through a personal electronic-validation link.
- Aegryn countersigns automatically when the client signs, with a named signatory, timestamp and document fingerprint. Additional signatories can receive individual validation links.
- Access to CIFSO certification evidence and data-room sections requires both a signed mutual NDA for the relevant account email and manual activation of the relevant section by Aegryn.

## Aegryn Talent (Select, /talent)

Aegryn selects executives and experts, and places transition profiles, at every stage of the company life cycle. Offers: key profile selection (search carried through to integration), transition profiles (fixed-duration assignment with written objectives and prepared handover), candidate pool (leadership profiles contacted only when an assignment matches). Typical roles: CTO, CISO, Head of AI, VP Engineering, Head of Data, Head of Product. Reply within two working days; no profile shared without the candidate's consent.
Pages: /talent, /talent/entreprises, /talent/candidats, /talent/transition. Related: /workforce (AI and labour-market data from World Economic Forum and PwC), /career.

---

## Network and partners (/alliances, /experts)

Aegryn calls on a network of experts selected one by one: experts for each of the eight disciplines, a circle of investors and institutions (Aegryn as operating partner of portfolio companies, /investisseurs), and independent auditors of CIFSO 5000 certification (/audit). The detailed expert directory (/annuaire) is internal and not indexed. Partnership activity families span advisory, legal and finance to engineering, design, technology, manufacturing and distribution.

The public Experts page (/experts, localised as /experten, /expertos, /esperti) presents eleven expertise domains with illustrative profiles: the eight disciplines (Business Strategy and Innovation, Risk Management and Compliance, Finance and Performance, Technology and Sovereignty, Operations and Operational Excellence, Talent and Organization, Project and Programme Management, M&A, Transactions and PMI), plus Board Advisory, Executive Search and Signature projects (design, engineering, manufacturing, procurement and logistics, distribution, legal and intellectual property for La Boutique). Participation in the network carries no promise of remuneration, subscription or volume of cases.

---

## Certification CIFSO 5000 (/grade): the ownership record of an organisation's value

Proprietary, independent, evidence-backed certification of organisations and their assets, comparable to an ownership deed for a company. A watch without its papers loses part of its value; an organisation whose value is not documented sells at a discount, is harder to finance and harder to transmit.

The certificate attests what the organisation owns, what it controls, what it is worth (source: Aegryn CIFSO Valuation Index) and what it can transmit. It is valid twelve months.

5 audited dimensions, each scored 0 to 20 points (total /100):
- **C, Code and Architecture:** the technology base, built or licensed (proprietary code quality, tests, technical debt, dependency freshness, documentation, CI/CD; licensed stack inventory, licence compliance, vendor concentration, reversibility and data export).
- **I, IP and Rights:** trademark, IP assignment of software, open-source licences, client and API contracts, litigation exposure.
- **F, Finance and Metrics:** ARR, NRR, churn, margins, TAM, auditability of figures.
- **S, Security, Sovereignty and AI Exposure:** cybersecurity posture, GDPR and Swiss FADP, production isolation, and AI exposure (inventory of AI services, usage policy, vendor contracts and DPA); heavy dependence on non-sovereign AI providers processing client data without safeguards is scored as a public risk.
- **O, Organisation, Talent and Succession:** founder dependency, key-person risk, succession plan, retention.

Regulatory compliance: each asset's regulatory perimeter is profiled, then validated during the audit. A regulation is only assessed when applicable. Controls are distributed across the dimensions that actually control them (EU Data Act and Cyber Resilience Act under C, ePrivacy, DSA and sanctions declarations under I, NIS2, DORA and EU AI Act under S, compliance governance under O). A non-compliant applicable regulation lowers the dimension score and caps the grade at AA.

| Grade | Color | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| AEG | #5ADDA4 (mint) | Apex, absolute excellence |
| AAA | #C9A84C (gold) | Premium |
| AA | #9BA8B0 (silver) | Solid |
| A | #4A90D9 (blue) | Standard |
| B | #D4820A (amber) | Early stage |

Certification cannot be replaced by a self-assessment or a third-party estimate for any certified valuation or transmission mandate handled by Aegryn.
Pages: /grade, /grade/brochure, /grade/submit, /audit, /verify (public certificate verification), /verify/[code].

---

## CIFSO Valuation Index (/valuation)

Benchmark engine shown to clients under one source name: "Aegryn CIFSO Valuation Index".

Data foundation, collected automatically every Monday 06:00 Europe/Zurich, Switzerland and Europe first: official open sources (Swiss National Bank, European Central Bank, Eurostat, official listed-company filing registries), Aegryn curated market multiples per industry, and published certified dossiers (medians and quartiles per dimension once a sufficient sample exists).

Access: free 15-minute self-assessment with an estimated grade and a deliberately wide illustrative range; extended access planned for validated profiles; certified valuation delivered with a published CIFSO 5000 grade.

Honest limitation: private M&A transaction multiples are not published by any official open source; licensed feeds (FactSet, PitchBook, Dealroom, Morningstar) are not currently used.

The free valuation tool inside /valuation is illustrative only: a client-side estimate from user-declared data, not an official Aegryn Grade.

## Aegryn Magazine (/magazine)

Quarterly publication on tech, money, deals, people and life, in English. Tagline: "Deals, multiples, portraits et art de vivre." Edition January 2027, "Built to Last": 154 pages, 96 articles in the web edition, nine data charts, an eight-page dossier on AI in the SME finance function, sourced 2026 data, six named 2026 deals, an interview with Julien Guex (FIT, Lausanne).
Pages: /magazine, /magazine/issue-01, /magazine/issue-01/web (the cover and flipbook views are not indexed).

Blog (/blog): market analyses and guides in six languages. Workforce (/workforce): employment and AI-skills data.

---

## Proprietary assets (/assets)

Software designed and operated by Aegryn, each carrying the line "An Aegryn company". Subblink (https://subblink.com): B2B SaaS, AI contract analysis, risk and obligation detection. The CIFSO protocol, a secure data room dedicated to certification evidence (access limited to Aegryn, assigned audit partners and the asset owner), a compliance engine and an identity-verification engine support the certification work. Signature projects of La Boutique are listed under /boutique/projets.

---

## Terms, privacy and help

Terms of Sale and Service (/terms/cgv, October 2026) cover advisory, project steering, CIFSO 5000 certification, executive selection, La Boutique, the expert network, publications and confidential mandates; Aegryn does not operate a marketplace or act as a financial intermediary. Terms of Use (/terms/use) include a confidential-access article tied to the mutual NDA. Also: /privacy, /security (fraud prevention, official sender domain @boha-group.com), /terms/ai-usage and the FAQ (/help/faq, 19 answers including "Is Aegryn a marketplace?", "What is La Boutique?" and "How does the NDA work?").

## Geography, compliance and philosophy

Headquarters: St-Sulpice, Switzerland. Serves Switzerland and Europe: CH, FR, DE, BE, LU, IT, ES, NL.
Regulatory: GDPR, Swiss FADP (LPD), EU AI Act aligned.
Name: from AEGIS (the shield of Zeus and Athena, protection), AEGIR (Norse god of the sea, mastery of flows) and AEON (eternity). "Aegryn protects what endures."
Swiss rigour shows in simplicity: clear decisions, careful work, no excess.
